situations.title: 척골신경 보호
situations.tagline: Let's tuck the arms with the forearms supinated so we take pressure off the ulnar nerves.
situations.brief: 척골신경 압박을 피하도록 팔 체위를 잡으세요.
keyPhrases: Keep the forearms supinated to protect the ulnar nerve.
Pad the elbows so there's no direct pressure.
Make sure the arm isn't pressing against the rail.

situations.title: 비골신경 압박 예방
situations.tagline: In lithotomy the fibular head presses right on the peroneal nerve — let's pad and check the legs.
situations.brief: 비골신경 압박을 예방하도록 다리를 패딩하세요.
keyPhrases: The fibular head can compress the peroneal nerve.
Let's pad the outer knee in the stirrups.
No hard surface should press against the lateral leg.

situations.title: 압력점 점검
situations.tagline: Before we drape, let's do a full pressure-point check — heels, elbows, sacrum, and occiput.
situations.brief: 주요 압박부를 드레이프 전 모두 점검하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's check all the pressure points before draping.
Heels, elbows, sacrum, and back of the head.
Everything's padded and nothing's compressed.

situations.title: 각막 눈 보호
situations.tagline: Eyes are taped and lubricated — we don't want any corneal abrasion during the case.
situations.brief: 각막 손상을 막도록 눈을 보호하세요.
keyPhrases: The eyes are lubricated and taped shut.
We want to prevent any corneal abrasion.
Nothing should rest against the eyes.

situations.title: 안면 압박 확인
situations.tagline: Let me check the ears and nose aren't folded or pinched under the headrest.
situations.brief: 귀와 코의 압박 여부를 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Let me make sure the ear isn't folded under.
The nose is clear of any pressure.
Nothing on the face is being pinched.

situations.title: 보호대 패딩 적용
situations.tagline: I'll pad under the safety strap so it holds without digging into the skin.
situations.brief: 보호대에 패딩을 적용해 압박을 완화하세요.
keyPhrases: I'll pad under the safety strap.
It should be secure but not digging in.
Two fingers of space under the strap.

situations.title: 상완신경총 견인 예방
situations.tagline: Keep the arm abducted under ninety degrees so we don't stretch the brachial plexus.
situations.brief: 상완신경총 견인을 막도록 팔 각도를 제한하세요.
keyPhrases: Keep arm abduction under ninety degrees.
Over-abduction stretches the brachial plexus.
Let's reposition the arm board a bit lower.
goals: 팔 외전 각도를 안전 범위로 제한한다

situations.title: 장시간 압박 조직 감시
situations.tagline: This case is running long — let's reassess the pressure points and skin integrity now.
situations.brief: 장시간 수술 중 압박 조직을 주기적으로 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: We're past the two-hour mark — let's reassess pressure points.
Check the skin integrity where padding sits.
Any sign of blanching or redness we should note.

situations.title: 복와위 안면 부종
situations.tagline: In prone, the face is dependent — let's confirm the eyes are clear and watch for facial edema.
situations.brief: 복와위에서 안면 부종과 안구 압박을 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: In prone, we watch closely for facial edema.
Confirm the eyes are free of any pressure.
Let me recheck the headrest position.

situations.title: 천골·발꿈치 욕창 위험
situations.tagline: The sacrum and heels take the most pressure supine — let's float the heels off the bed.
situations.brief: 천골과 발꿈치의 압박성 손상을 예방하세요.
keyPhrases: The sacrum and heels are high-risk pressure areas.
Let's float the heels off the surface.
Add padding under the sacrum.

situations.title: 팔 외전 각도 제한
situations.tagline: The arm board is a little high — let's bring the abduction back under ninety to be safe.
situations.brief: 팔 외전 각도를 안전 범위로 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: That abduction looks over ninety degrees.
Let's bring the arm board down a notch.
We want to avoid stretching the nerve.
goals: 팔 외전 각도를 안전 범위로 조정한다

situations.title: 체형별 압박 관리
situations.tagline: This patient is quite thin, so the bony prominences need extra padding this case.
situations.brief: 환자 체형에 맞춰 압박 부위 관리를 달리하세요.
keyPhrases: This patient is thin, so bony prominences are at higher risk.
Let's add extra padding at the pressure points.
We'll tailor the padding to their body habitus.

situations.title: 취약군 말초 보호
situations.tagline: She's diabetic with poor circulation, so let's be extra careful with the extremities.
situations.brief: 당뇨·혈관 취약 환자의 말초를 중점 보호하세요.
keyPhrases: She's diabetic with compromised circulation.
Let's minimize any pressure on the extremities.
We'll check distal perfusion more often.

situations.title: 말초 순환 감시
situations.tagline: Let me check the pulses and skin temperature distal to the strap every so often.
situations.brief: 말초 순환과 온도를 주기적으로 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Let me check distal pulses and skin temperature.
Circulation below the strap looks intact.
I'll recheck perfusion periodically.

situations.title: 체위 재조정 압박 완화
situations.tagline: Long case — with the surgeon's okay, let's micro-reposition to relieve the pressure points.
situations.brief: 주기적 재배치로 압박을 완화하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's micro-reposition to offload the pressure points.
I'll clear it with the surgeon first.
Even small shifts help relieve compression.

situations.title: 술후 신경 손상 발견
situations.tagline: My hand's been numb and weak since I woke up — is that from how I was lying during surgery?
situations.brief: 술후 신경 손상을 사정하고 환자에게 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: Let me check the strength and sensation in your hand.
Some positioning-related numbness can happen and often improves.
I'll document this and have the team evaluate it.

situations.title: 급성 시력 손상 의심
situations.tagline: Everything looks blurry and dark on one side since I woke up — what's happening to my eyes?
situations.brief: 술후 급성 시력 손상 위험을 사정하고 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Tell me exactly what you can and can't see.
I'm going to have the doctor evaluate this right away.
We take any change in vision very seriously.

situations.title: 구획증후군 조기 징후
situations.tagline: The calf is tense and the patient's pain is out of proportion — I'm worried about compartment syndrome.
situations.brief: 구획증후군 조기 징후를 인지하고 알리세요.
keyPhrases: The compartment feels tense and firm.
Pain is out of proportion to the exam.
We need to escalate this immediately.

situations.title: 압박성 횡문근융해 의심
situations.tagline: After that long case the urine looks tea-colored — I'm thinking rhabdo from prolonged pressure.
situations.brief: 압박성 횡문근융해 의심 소견을 보고하세요.
keyPhrases: The urine is dark, tea-colored.
After prolonged pressure I'm concerned about rhabdo.
Let's send a CK and notify the team.

situations.title: 장시간 수술 손상 재평가
situations.tagline: That was an eight-hour case — let's do a head-to-toe skin and neuro reassessment before handoff.
situations.brief: 장시간 수술 후 손상 여부를 전신 재평가하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's do a full skin and neuro reassessment.
After eight hours we check every pressure point.
Document findings before we hand off.
goals: 장시간 수술 후 손상을 전신 재평가한다

situations.title: 손상 발생 기록·보고
situations.tagline: There's a positioning-related injury here — I need to document it accurately and file an incident report.
situations.brief: 발생한 손상을 정확히 기록하고 보고하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm documenting the injury with objective findings.
This needs an incident report for follow-up.
Accurate records protect the patient and the team.
